mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user actor JOIN t_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = actor.id JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.status = 1 AND actor.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.code = 'security:manage' )
SELECT link_security_revision FROM t_user WHERE id = #{targetUserId} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO t_user_link_security_restriction (id, user_id, mode, range_start, range_end, reason_code) VALUES ( uuidv7(), #{targetUserId}, #{mode}, #{rangeStart}, #{rangeEnd}, #{reasonCode} ) RETURNING id
UPDATE t_user SET link_security_revision = link_security_revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{targetUserId} RETURNING link_security_revision
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_outbox_event (id, event_type, schema_version, stream_key, partition_key, trace_id, payload) SELECT event_id, 'UserLinkSecurityRestrictionsChanged', 1, 'USER_LINK_SECURITY:' || #{targetUserId}::text, #{targetUserId}::text, #{traceId}, jsonb_build_object( 'eventId', event_id::text, 'eventType', 'UserLinkSecurityRestrictionsChanged', 'schemaVersion', 1, 'streamKey', 'USER_LINK_SECURITY:' || #{targetUserId}::text, 'revision', #{revision}, 'occurredAt', occurred_at, 'traceId', #{traceId}, 'payload', jsonb_build_object( 'userId', #{targetUserId}::text, 'restrictions', ( SELECT COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'restrictionId', restriction.id::text, 'mode', restriction.mode, 'rangeStart', restriction.range_start, 'rangeEnd', restriction.range_end, 'reasonCode', restriction.reason_code, 'createdAt', restriction.created_at ) ORDER BY restriction.created_at, restriction.id ), '[]'::jsonb ) FROM t_user_link_security_restriction restriction WHERE restriction.user_id = #{targetUserId} AND restriction.active ) ) ) FROM (SELECT uuidv7() AS event_id, now() AS occurred_at) generated
